source: apple-importer; records what the Apple app does today, NOT a target
notes: A .json file that is not a ChatGPT export. Stand-in for the puller's <id>.json payload, whose real schema is not documented in the repository.

Apple imports the raw JSON text as one message of role unknown and labels it Claude because the text contains that word. The web app refuses it with a clear reason and lets the user choose to keep it as a plain-text note.
